webhook.title: Webhook setup
webhook.httpsWarning: LINE requires an HTTPS webhook URL
webhook.step1: Open LINE Developers Console and select the OA's Messaging API channel
webhook.step2: On the Messaging API tab, edit Webhook URL, paste the URL above and select Update
webhook.step3: Select Verify. After Success, turn on Use webhook and Webhook redelivery if available
webhook.step4: Turn off Auto-reply messages and Greeting messages in LINE Official Account Manager
